items.title: Slotkin faces GOP backlash after suggesting probes could deter young people from joining the Trump administration
items.brief: Democratic Sen. Elissa Slotkin is drawing criticism from a Republican lawmaker and other conservatives after suggesting congressional investigations could deter recent graduates from joining the Trump administration.

items.title: What we know about the investigation into the Bend school shooting
items.brief: Students in this Oregon community won’t be returning to classes on Monday as they continue to mourn three classmates and a teacher killed in the United States’ latest school shooting, the motive of which is still…

items.title: Several French cities impose curfews after weekend of chaos and protests spreading to parts of Europe
items.brief: French officials are imposing localized curfews — including in parts of Paris — as the country reels from its worst rioting in years.

items.title: Russian satellite makes possibly unprecedented approach to another spacecraft without permission
items.brief: A rare move by a Russian-made satellite may have brought it within less than a mile of a commercial Earth-observation satellite that may be used to provide national security services to countries such as Ukraine.

items.title: Kenyan cult leader found guilty over 190 children starved to death in the hope of ‘meeting Jesus’
items.brief: The leader of a Kenyan Christian cult has been found guilty of the murder of 190 children through an organised system of enforced fasting and abuse.

items.title: Jon Stewart to stay at ‘The Daily Show’ through the 2028 election
items.brief: Jon Stewart will remain at the helm of Comedy Central’s “The Daily Show” through December 2028, extending his once-a-week hosting role through the next presidential election.

items.title: Mississippi attorney general says use of force was justified in death of 1-year-old Kohen Wiley
items.brief: Mississippi’s attorney general says a Senatobia police officer was justified in the June shooting death of a 1-year-old boy while responding to a shoplifting call.

items.title: US airman who died after rappel fall at a college football game in Texas is identified
items.brief: The US airman who died after a rapid fall while rappelling from the rafters of a stadium before a college football game in Texas was a 15-year service member from Georgia, according to the Air Force.
